title: docs: retire the npm 10 `edgesOut` notes in Getting Started, Troubleshooting and Self-hosting — their own removal condition now holds
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured docs defect with named locations. Found while landing #28958, whose PR #29084 narrows the same note on Your First Project only.
Reader: `domain:devx` (docs on-ramp), one PR on `content/docs/getting-started/index.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` and `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "edgesOut npm 10 docs" → #28958 (open, Your First Project only), #23849 / #23805 / #23806 / #22912 (closed, the original npm 10 failure and the notes this card retires), #24926 / #24974 (closed, the separate pnpm-project `npm install --save-dev` case). None retires these notes.
reach: public docs. Measured by the #28958 dev on 2026-11-02 with Node 22.23.4 and npm 10.9.9: dry-run installs of `@objectstack/cli@18.2.0` and `@objectstack/plugin-auth@18.2.0` exit 0 with no `edgesOut`; `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` 4.1.12 was published 2026-10-30.
type: Bug

Business reason: these pages still tell every Node 22 reader that npm 10 cannot install the CLI and that they must upgrade npm first. That is no longer true, so a newcomer does an unneeded global npm upgrade, or gives up on the default toolchain.

## Where

`content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` line 30 sets the removal condition for all of these notes: "can be removed once `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` publishes the version that `npm view vitest dist-tags` lists as `V4`, and a plain npm 10 install of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` passes." Both halves now hold. Still stating the failure on `main`:
- `content/docs/getting-started/index.mdx` lines 173–175 ("npm 10 cannot install the CLI right now").
- `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` lines 13–30 (the whole `edgesOut` entry).
- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` line 171 (the Dockerfile comment) and lines 365–366 (the npm 11 install step).

## Wanted

- Re-measure the removal condition at the time of the PR (`npm view vitest dist-tags`, a plain npm 10 install of `@objectstack/plugin-auth`) and record the reading in the PR.
- If it holds: remove or narrow each note, as #29084 did on Your First Project. Keep any vitest pin advice that is still needed for its own reason (the GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 note on `~4.0.0`).
- ⛔ Leave the separate pnpm-project `npm install --save-dev` note in `ai/skills.mdx` / `ai/skills-reference.mdx` alone: it is a different failure.
